name: Gen1BattleUI
description: The battle command and move menus as four buttons in a 2x2 grid instead of a list, inside the Game Boy's own screen and the Game Boy's own chrome. FIGHT, PKMN, ITEM and RUN each get a box of their own; so do the four moves, with a panel above carrying the highlighted move's full name, its PP, and its type in that type's own colour, with the move names on the buttons coloured to match. Opening the bag leaves the buttons up and marks ITEM with a hollow hand. Dialogue still takes the bottom of the screen back for as long as it is talking. Includes the Gen 2 style XP bar under your Pokemon, drawn under the move panel rather than across it. Both battle layouts, CLASSIC and WIDE.
